doris:position-deletes:v2.notes: Doris 4.2 writes Iceberg V2 position delete files for DELETE, UPDATE, and MERGE INTO; it also reads existing position deletes.
caveats: Row-level DML is documented as experimental in Doris 4.x.

doris:position-deletes:v3.notes: Not applicable to new V3 writes: Iceberg V3 prohibits adding position delete files. Doris writes deletion vectors instead and can still read position deletes inherited from V2.
caveats: This write-rated feature is displayed only for V2.

doris:equality-deletes:v2.notes: Not supported as a write operation. Doris reads equality delete files on V2 tables via its Iceberg catalog connector but has no write path that produces them -- writing equality deletes requires another engine (e.g. a Flink upsert sink).

doris:equality-deletes:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 does not write equality delete files to V3 tables; its row-level DML writes deletion vectors. Existing V3 equality delete files remain valid and readable.
caveats: Iceberg V3 permits existing and newly written equality delete files; the absence here is a Doris write-path limitation.

doris:merge-on-read:v2.notes: Doris 4.x supports merge-on-read for V2 tables using Position Delete files; DML writes (UPDATE/DELETE/MERGE INTO) emit position deletes

doris:merge-on-read:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 supports merge-on-read for V3 tables using Puffin-format Deletion Vectors; V3 DML writes Deletion Vectors rather than position delete files

doris:copy-on-write:v2.notes: Doris DML uses merge-on-read (Position Deletes on V2); copy-on-write is not implemented
caveats: Doris writes Position Delete files, not rewritten data files, for UPDATE/DELETE/MERGE INTO

doris:copy-on-write:v3.notes: Doris DML uses merge-on-read (Deletion Vectors on V3); copy-on-write is not implemented
caveats: Doris writes Puffin Deletion Vectors, not rewritten data files, for V3 UPDATE/DELETE/MERGE INTO

doris:schema-evolution:v2.notes: Doris supports ALTER TABLE schema changes (add/drop/rename/reorder columns) on Iceberg tables; schema evolution was added in Doris 3.1.0

doris:schema-evolution:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 supports ALTER TABLE schema changes on V3 Iceberg tables

doris:type-promotion:v2.notes: Doris supports safe type promotions such as INT → BIGINT and FLOAT → DOUBLE on Iceberg tables, added in Doris 4.0.4

doris:type-promotion:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 supports safe type promotions on V3 Iceberg tables

doris:column-default-values:v2.notes: Column default values are a V3 feature; not applicable to V2

doris:column-default-values:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 reads Iceberg V3 initial-default values for older files, applies write-default values to omitted INSERT columns, and resolves explicit DEFAULT expressions in INSERT, UPDATE, and MERGE.
caveats: Complex-type and Variant defaults have type-specific restrictions.

links.label: Doris initial and write default regression test

doris:table-creation:v2.notes: Doris supports CREATE TABLE and CREATE TABLE AS SELECT (CTAS) against its Iceberg catalog

doris:table-creation:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 can create V3 Iceberg tables via CREATE TABLE with the 'format-version' = '3' table property

doris:time-travel:v2.notes: Doris supports time travel via FOR TIME AS OF and FOR VERSION AS OF SQL syntax on Iceberg tables

doris:time-travel:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 supports FOR TIME AS OF and FOR VERSION AS OF on V3 Iceberg tables

doris:table-maintenance:v2.notes: Doris supports ALTER TABLE ... EXECUTE maintenance actions including rewrite_data_files, expire_snapshots, rewrite_manifests, rollback_to_snapshot, and fast_forward

doris:table-maintenance:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 supports table maintenance actions on V3 Iceberg tables via ALTER TABLE ... EXECUTE

doris:branching-tagging:v2.notes: Doris supports Branch and Tag management via ALTER TABLE ... CREATE BRANCH/TAG, added in Doris 3.1.0

doris:branching-tagging:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 supports branch and tag management on V3 Iceberg tables

doris:hidden-partitioning:v2.notes: Doris supports Iceberg partition transforms: year, month, day, hour, bucket, truncate, and identity

doris:hidden-partitioning:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 supports the full set of Iceberg partition transforms on V3 tables: year, month, day, hour, bucket, truncate, and identity

doris:partition-evolution:v2.notes: Doris supports ADD/DROP/REPLACE PARTITION KEY operations, added in Doris 4.0.2

doris:partition-evolution:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 supports partition evolution on V3 Iceberg tables

doris:multi-arg-transforms:v2.notes: Multi-argument transforms are a V3 feature; not applicable to V2

doris:multi-arg-transforms:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 partition DDL handles single-source transforms; reading a table with a multi-argument transform has not been measured.
caveats: The current partition builder has no multi-source transform case; read compatibility needs an external fixture.

doris:read-support:v2.notes: Doris 4.x provides full read support for Iceberg V1 and V2 tables via the Iceberg catalog

doris:read-support:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 reads V3 tables with supported column types, including tables with deletion vectors, row lineage, and Variant columns.
caveats: Iceberg V3 Geometry, Geography, Unknown, and nanosecond timestamp types are not mapped as readable Doris columns.

doris:write-insert:v2.notes: Doris supports INSERT INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE, and CREATE TABLE AS SELECT (CTAS) against V2 Iceberg tables

doris:write-insert:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 supports INSERT INTO, INSERT OVERWRITE, and CTAS against V3 Iceberg tables

doris:write-merge-update-delete:v2.notes: Doris 4.2 supports UPDATE, DELETE, and MERGE INTO against V2 Iceberg tables, writing Position Delete files
caveats: UPDATE, DELETE, and MERGE INTO are documented as experimental in Doris 4.x.

doris:write-merge-update-delete:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 UPDATE, DELETE, and MERGE INTO on V3 Iceberg tables write Puffin Deletion Vectors
caveats: UPDATE, DELETE, and MERGE INTO are documented as experimental in Doris 4.x.

doris:catalog-integration:v2.notes: Doris supports the Iceberg catalog types hms, rest, hadoop, glue, dlf, jdbc, and s3tables

doris:catalog-integration:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 supports the same catalog types (hms, rest, hadoop, glue, dlf, jdbc, s3tables) for V3 Iceberg tables

doris:statistics:v2.notes: Doris uses Iceberg manifest column metrics (min/max, null counts) for query planning and predicate pushdown

doris:statistics:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 uses manifest column metrics for V3 Iceberg query planning and predicate pushdown

doris:bloom-filters:v2.notes: Puffin bloom-filter sidecars are not documented for Doris's Iceberg connector
caveats: Puffin bloom-filter sidecar support for Iceberg is not documented in Doris 4.x

doris:bloom-filters:v3.notes: Puffin bloom-filter sidecars are not documented for Doris's Iceberg connector on V3 tables
caveats: Puffin bloom-filter sidecar support for Iceberg is not documented in Doris 4.x

doris:aws-glue-catalog:v2.notes: Doris supports AWS Glue as an Iceberg catalog via the glue catalog type
caveats: AWS Glue integration is read-only; DDL and data write-back are not supported

doris:aws-glue-catalog:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 supports AWS Glue for V3 Iceberg tables via the glue catalog type
caveats: AWS Glue integration is read-only; DDL and data write-back are not supported

doris:rest-catalog:v2.notes: Doris supports the Iceberg REST Catalog via the rest catalog type

doris:rest-catalog:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 supports the Iceberg REST Catalog for V3 tables

doris:unity-catalog:v2.notes: Doris 4.2 supports the generic Iceberg REST Catalog protocol, but this specific Unity Catalog pairing has not been tested end to end for Iceberg V2.
caveats: Generic REST support does not establish this provider-specific authentication, credential vending, and read/write behavior.

doris:unity-catalog:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 supports the generic Iceberg REST Catalog protocol, but this specific Unity Catalog pairing has not been tested end to end for Iceberg V3.
caveats: Generic REST support does not establish this provider-specific authentication, credential vending, and read/write behavior.

doris:snowflake-horizon-catalog:v2.notes: Doris 4.2 supports the generic Iceberg REST Catalog protocol, but this specific Snowflake Horizon pairing has not been tested end to end for Iceberg V2.
caveats: Generic REST support does not establish this provider-specific authentication, credential vending, and read/write behavior.

doris:snowflake-horizon-catalog:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 supports the generic Iceberg REST Catalog protocol, but this specific Snowflake Horizon pairing has not been tested end to end for Iceberg V3.
caveats: Generic REST support does not establish this provider-specific authentication, credential vending, and read/write behavior.

doris:variant-type:v2.notes: Variant type is a V3 feature; not applicable to V2

doris:variant-type:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 reads V3 Variant values, including nested and shredded Parquet data, and writes unshredded Variant values to V3 Parquet tables.
caveats: Iceberg VARIANT DDL supports only top-level columns.
Variant writes require Parquet and reject write.parquet.shred-variants=true; ORC Variant writes are unsupported.

links.label: Doris Variant read and write regression test

doris:shredded-variant:v2.notes: Shredded Variant is a V3 feature; not applicable to V2

doris:shredded-variant:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 reads standards-compliant shredded Variant Parquet files and can query them alongside unshredded Variant files.
caveats: Doris rejects writes when write.parquet.shred-variants=true; it writes only unshredded Variant.

doris:geometry-type:v2.notes: Geometry type is a V3 feature; not applicable to V2

doris:geometry-type:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 does not map Iceberg V3 Geometry/Geography columns to a Doris column type; the schema conversion falls through to an unsupported-type error.
caveats: Based on the current FE schema mapper; no end-to-end fixture was run for this audit.

doris:nanosecond-timestamps:v2.notes: Nanosecond timestamps are a V3 feature; not applicable to V2

doris:nanosecond-timestamps:v3.notes: Doris's Iceberg datetime precision is microsecond (precision 6), per the Doris 4.x Iceberg column-type mapping table; nanosecond precision is not supported
caveats: Doris Iceberg datetime precision is microsecond only (precision 6)

doris:lineage:v2.notes: Row Lineage is a V3 feature; not applicable to V2

doris:lineage:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 generates and exposes _row_id and _last_updated_sequence_number for V3 tables; regression tests cover INSERT, UPDATE, MERGE, and data-file rewrite.
caveats: Row Lineage is documented as experimental; this audit did not execute the regression suite.

links.label: Doris V3 lineage DML regression test

doris:deletion-vectors:v2.notes: Deletion vectors are a V3 feature; not applicable to Iceberg V2

doris:deletion-vectors:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 writes Puffin deletion vectors for DELETE, UPDATE, and MERGE INTO on V3 tables and reads them during scans.

doris:unknown-type:v2.notes: Unknown type is a V3 feature, not available in format version 2

doris:unknown-type:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 does not map Iceberg V3 Unknown columns to a Doris column type; the schema conversion falls through to an unsupported-type error.
caveats: Based on the current FE schema mapper; no end-to-end fixture was run for this audit.

doris:google-lakehouse:v2.notes: Doris 4.2 supports the generic Iceberg REST Catalog protocol, but this specific Google Lakehouse pairing has not been tested end to end for Iceberg V2.
caveats: Generic REST support does not establish this provider-specific authentication, credential vending, and read/write behavior.

doris:google-lakehouse:v3.notes: Doris 4.2 supports the generic Iceberg REST Catalog protocol, but this specific Google Lakehouse pairing has not been tested end to end for Iceberg V3.
caveats: Generic REST support does not establish this provider-specific authentication, credential vending, and read/write behavior.
